The prosecution, in order to prove its case,
has examined PWs.1 to 4 and got marked Ex.P.1 to 8.
During cross examination Ex.D.1 got marked by confront.

On closure of the evidence on the side of the prosecution, the statement of the accused u/sec. 313 Cr.PC came to be recorded, the accused has denied the  4 C.C.28359/2018 incriminating evidence appearing against him and chosen to lead defence evidence.
5. Heard the arguments.
Perused the documents placed on record.

6. The points that arise for consideration are :
 1. Whether the prosecution has proved  beyond all reasonable doubt that  accused has committed the offence u/s  498A of I.P.C. ?
 2. What order ?
 7. The above points are answered as under :
 Point No.1: In the Negative.

Point No.2: As per final order for the following :
 REASONS

8. Point No.1 : The case of the prosecution is that, accused tortured CW.1 by restraining her to meet her family relation and talk to others, abused with filthy language by demanding dowry, due to which CW.1 stayed at her sister's house.

 9.

The Ld. Sr.APP for the state during the course of argument has submitted that prosecution has examined complainant as PW.1, in her evidence PW.1 deposed about torture given by accused demanding dowry and thereby supported the prosecution case.

PW.3 family friend of PW.1 deposed supporting the prosecution case, testimony of PW.1 is corroborated testimony of PW.3 and police official has supported the case of prosecution by deposing manner in which he has conducted investigation and filed charge sheet against accused for offence alleged.

No doubt, it is true that marriage was held 15 years back and they have two children and accused has deposited amount in the bank, that does not mean that PW.1 was lived with accused happily and accused did not torture PW.1, she  6 C.C.28359/2018 has tolerated torture of accused since long time and finally act of accused was outburst, so, PW.1 lodged first information.

Therefore, the evidence placed by prosecution through prosecution witnesses and Smt Anitha Kashvani vs Girish Kumar Kashvani on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158234422/
4 documentary evidence are clearly establishes that the accused has committed the offense as alleged in the charge sheet.

10. Per contra, the learned counsel appearing for accused during the course of argument has submitted that though the prosecution has examined complainant as PW.1 and family friend of PW.1 as PW.2 and police official, PW.2 has not deposed supporting prosecution case and turned hostile.
PW.3 is not an eye witness, he is hearsay witness and evidence of hearsay witness will not help to prove guilt of accused.

Police official has deposed reagrding investigation, so, in order to prove ingredients of offence punishable under section 498A, except oral  7 C.C.28359/2018 testimony of PW.1, no singal document is placed on record.

As admitted by PW.1 in the cross examiantion,
the accused has deposited an amount of Rs.5,00,000/-
in bank in the name of each children and paying maiantenance amount regulary.
It is further argued that as per Ex.P.1 first information relief sought by PW.1 is only to get her chidlren seperate from accused and to get maintenance from accused.

Therefore,
taking into consideration the evidence of witnesses and Smt Anitha Kashvani vs Girish Kumar Kashvani on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158234422/
5 documents palced by prosecution, it can be said that prosecution has not been able to prove guilt of accused beyond reasonable doubt.

sentences.text: Hence, the prosecution has failed to prove allegation made in the charge sheet.
Therefore, the accused is entitled to benefit of doubt and prays for acquit the accused.

11. In the light of the submission made above,
on careful perusal of oral and documentary evidence placed by the prosecution, marriage of accused and PW.1 was held in the year 2002, due to their wedlock  8 C.C.28359/2018 first child born in the year 2005 and second child born in the year 2011, the accused has deposited an amount of Rs.5,00,000/- each in the name of two children and paying maintenance amount to PW.1 and his children as per Ex.D.1, is not in dispute.

In order to believe the version of prosecution, perusal of Ex.P.1 first information, evidence of PW.1 and PW.3, reveals that PW.1 did not made allegation regarding dowry harassment of accused, the relief sought by PW.1 is only to get her children from custody of accused and get maintenance by him.

Further, in the evidence of PW.1 deposed that she never lodge first information against accused for demanded to bring dowry and she never lodged first information before this case against accused for any harassment caused by him.

Beside,

as per his evidence, accused did not beat her in his presence.

sentences.text: PW.2 is neighbor of PW.1 in her evidence she has not deposed supporting the prosecution case and  9 C.C.28359/2018 turned hostile.
PW.4 is investigating officer, being police official naturally deposed supporting prosecution case regarding investigation.

Therefore,
there is no sufficient reliable and cogent evidence on record to prove the guilt of accused beyond reasonable doubt.

12. Therefore, in view of discussion made above,
the considered opinion is of the court that, the prosecution has failed to prove the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
The accused is entitled to benefit of doubt.
Hence, answered the point No.1 in the Negative.
13. Point No.2:

In view of discussion made on point No.1 this court proceeds to pass following  ORDER Acting under section 248(1) of Cr.P.C the accused is acquitted of the offence punishable under section - 498A of I.P.C.
Bail bond of accused and his surety bond stands cancelled after six months from today.
